filing_office: Indiana Secretary of State, Business Services Division
filing_fee_notes: Confirmed paper Articles of Organization fee. Online formation fee was not confirmed. Business Entity Report is 32 online or 50 on paper.
registered_agent_rules: Designate an agent at an Indiana address to receive service of process. The LLC cannot serve as its own registered agent.
annual_report_due: First due two years after formation, then every other year in the anniversary month. INBiz states the anniversary date is the due date, with the remainder of that month before the report is past due.
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and designate an Indiana registered agent. File a Business Entity Report every two years.
common_mistake: Assuming paying business taxes replaces the Business Entity Report.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Formation fee field records paper filing, not an unverified online price. Official indexed form and INBiz text supplied fees and report timing; some direct fetches were blocked or returned only application shells. Name reservation fee, direct name-search URL, formation processing time, expedite options, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
